name: read-only-reentrancy
description: Read-only reentrancy allows reading manipulated price during callback

ground_truth.title: Read-only reentrancy allows price manipulation
ground_truth.root_cause: removeLiquidity updates totalSupply AFTER the external ETH transfer, making the price() getter temporarily report incorrect values
ground_truth.violated_invariant: External view functions must not return inconsistent state during external calls
ground_truth.failure_predicate: Attacker can read a manipulated value from price() during the fallback of removeLiquidity
attack_path: 2. Contract calculates ETH amount and sends ETH to attacker
4. Attacker calls price() in the fallback
5. totalEth is decremented but totalSupply is NOT decremented yet
6. price() returns an artificially low value
7. Attacker uses this manipulated price in another integrated protocol

economic_impact.max_extractable: Depends on the integrated protocol using the price oracle

pass_criteria.must_mention_root_cause: state updated after external call allows reading stale/inconsistent state
